import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Create age from Year_Birth and calculate total spending
current_year = 2014  # Based on the dates in the data
df['Age'] = current_year - df['Year_Birth']
df['TotalSpending'] = (df['MntWines'] + df['MntFruits'] + df['MntMeatProducts'] + 
                       df['MntFishProducts'] + df['MntSweetProducts'] + df['MntGoldProds'])

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Income vs Total Spending by Education (scatter)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
education_order = ['PhD', 'Master', 'Graduation', '2n Cycle', 'Basic']
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(df['Education'].unique()))
for i, edu in enumerate(df['Education'].unique()):
    mask = df['Education'] == edu
    ax1.scatter(df[mask]['Income'], df[mask]['TotalSpending'], 
               alpha=0.5, s=30, label=edu, color=colors[i])
ax1.set_xlabel('Income ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Spending ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Income vs Total Spending by Education Level', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Education', fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age Distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
ax2.hist(df['Age'], bins=30, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Age (years)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Customer Age Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 3. Spending by Category
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
spending_categories = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 
                       'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
category_totals = [df[cat].sum() for cat in spending_categories]
category_labels = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
colors_pie = sns.color_palette("Set2", len(category_labels))
ax3.pie(category_totals, labels=category_labels, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors_pie, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Spending Distribution by Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Total Spending by Marital Status
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
marital_spending = df.groupby('Marital_Status')['TotalSpending'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = ax4.bar(range(len(marital_spending)), marital_spending.values, 
               color=sns.color_palette("viridis", len(marital_spending)))
ax4.set_xticks(range(len(marital_spending)))
ax4.set_xticklabels(marital_spending.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax4.set_ylabel('Average Total Spending ($)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Average Spending by Marital Status', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 5. Number of children vs Spending
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
df['TotalKids'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
kids_spending = df.groupby('TotalKids')['TotalSpending'].mean()
ax5.plot(kids_spending.index, kids_spending.values, marker='o', 
         linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='crimson')
ax5.set_xlabel('Number of Children at Home', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Average Total Spending ($)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Spending vs Number of Children', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 6. Purchase Channel Comparison
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
channels = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases', 'NumDealsPurchases']
channel_labels = ['Web', 'Catalog', 'Store', 'Deals']
channel_totals = [df[ch].sum() for ch in channels]
bars = ax6.barh(channel_labels, channel_totals, color=sns.color_palette("mako", len(channels)))
ax6.set_xlabel('Total Number of Purchases', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Purchases by Channel', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# 7. Campaign Acceptance Rate
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
campaigns = ['AcceptedCmp1', 'AcceptedCmp2', 'AcceptedCmp3', 'AcceptedCmp4', 'AcceptedCmp5', 'Response']
acceptance_rates = [df[cmp].mean() * 100 for cmp in campaigns]
campaign_labels = ['Cmp1', 'Cmp2', 'Cmp3', 'Cmp4', 'Cmp5', 'Last Cmp']
bars = ax7.bar(campaign_labels, acceptance_rates, color=sns.color_palette("rocket", len(campaigns)))
ax7.set_ylabel('Acceptance Rate (%)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Campaign Acceptance Rates', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')
ax7.set_ylim(0, max(acceptance_rates) * 1.2)

# 8. Recency vs Web Visits
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax8.scatter(df['Recency'], df['NumWebVisitsMonth'], alpha=0.4, s=20, color='darkgreen')
ax8.set_xlabel('Recency (days since last purchase)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_ylabel('Web Visits per Month', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_title('Recency vs Web Activity', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.grid(alpha=0.3)

plt.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Analysis Dashboard', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
